releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 release package with the staged ShareSurfer Start Menu and text-console wizard foundation from #367. The release-root Start-ShareSurfer.ps1 launcher now opens the Start-ShareSurfer menu by default, while -ConfigPath still replays saved startup configs. The menu shows readiness for ownership inputs, guided scan setup, export validation, standalone dashboard packaging, stop gates, and support bundle guidance; runnable entries preview the commands they execute before asking for confirmation. Ownership import prompts are safer for first-time admins: Enter accepts an existing suggestion, but when no suggestion exists ShareSurfer stays on that field and asks for a numbered/header choice or an explicit S skip. Command previews now quote Windows paths safely and avoid provider errors during non-Windows development checks. The package includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
